observations.source_title: Amana ZrN-Coated and Uncoated 2D/3D Carving CNC Solid Carbide Router Bits v8
observations.source_page: page 2, 3 Flute Extra Long Ball Nose & Flat Bottom, 1/4" column, Wood/MDF/Sign-Foam row
observations.ap_rule: 1xD use recommended feed rate; 2xD reduce 25%; 3xD reduce 50%
observations.machine_assumption: chart at 18000 rpm, 1xD DOC; CPT range 0.004-0.006 in = 0.1016-0.1524 mm
observations.notes: Printed row for the chart's '3 Flute Extra Long Ball Nose & Flat Bottom' block (46490, 46491, 46493, 46496, 46590, 46593, 46596, 46597); one printed cell serves both ball nose and flat bottom. Tool geometry (derived from toolstoday_amana_4649x_specs, not printed on the chart): 46490 (ZrN) / 46490-K (Spektra): 1/4 D, 1/2 CH, relieved neck D1 .235 in to L1 1-1/4 in, 1/4 shank, 4 in OAL. Same-chart standard-length comparison (derived, for G8 only): no standard 3-flute 1/4 in column; the 6 mm standard 3-flute ball column prints 0.004-0.006 in. The chart prints no stickout or L/D; 'extra long' is a catalog class with a relieved neck and a short flute, so a ratio against the standard row is not a pure stickout effect. Material split follows the LUT convention for this chart (softwood and MDF only; the chart does not split hardwood). hardness_value is the engine's own Janka proxy for the family, as in the LUT rows of this chart.
